features.note: The facade sign, numbered room thresholds, abstract poster panels, route markings, and suppressible wayfinding reinforce the front threshold and central spine without protected movie imagery.
The Sala 3 pair preserves the room and seat massing while showing aisle stripes, wall-panel rhythm, and a deterministic abstract screen-content change.
Facade identity, the long concession line, generated menu boards, service fixtures, and frame-to-frame menu changes read as one coherent public sequence.

Media colors and the UG67 callout read, but the amber direction markers resolve as cross-, T-, or L-like clusters in the UG67 view and become too small to establish direction in the complete-network preset; many endpoint/terminal cues are also below readable size there.

Opaque architectural captures and the translucent engineering captures remain spatially coherent, while the corridor labels-on/off pair cleanly suppresses labels without changing the underlying scene.

important_features.note: People, door banks, counters, seating, and the compact UG67 device retain plausible relative scale; device readability comes from callouts rather than obvious enlargement.
Surface colors and emissive-style signs separate public, corridor, and auditorium zones sufficiently for this pre-lighting pass, although the final brightness hierarchy is not yet being required.
Roof duct runs and engineering routes visibly follow the building, but dense crossings and small terminal cues keep some endpoint containment from reading cleanly at the complete-network preset.

defects: In the UG67 engineering capture, amber direction markers read as chunky orthogonal crosses, T shapes, or L shapes rather than as single directional arrows, and several overlap nearby cyan route/equipment forms.
In the complete-network capture, the amber markers and many endpoint or terminal labels are too small to communicate direction and identity at the required preset.

The elevated corridor view is visually dominated by roof-frame members crossing the image, which weakens the immediate read of room-number and evacuation wayfinding even though those surface elements are present.
corrections: Rebuild each amber direction marker as one unmistakable arrowhead aligned to the local route tangent; remove the cross-like hub/secondary arms, enlarge its projected silhouette at the complete-network preset, and offset it from bends, equipment, and cyan route segments.

Increase priority and readable projected size for canonical TC300, UC100, and UG67 endpoint IDs and terminal cues in the complete-network preset while culling lower-priority zone labels that compete with them.
Lower or reposition the corridor evidence camera so room numbers, exit markings, posters, and carpet cues form the focal corridor read instead of being repeatedly crossed by roof-frame members.

mechanical.note: All 14 attempt-3 capture sidecars are reported clean; 212 draws and 35000 tris are within the 550-draw/750000-triangle budget. SwiftShader fps is informational only.
